status: parameters frozen before controlled benchmark quality scores
interface: reconstruct(samples, pattern, target, method, noise_sigma=0) -> float32 linear full plane

input_contract.units: pre-normalized linear (DN-black_phase)/(white_phase-black_phase); negative and above-white allowed
input_contract.non_target_values: never read or validated; may contain NaN
input_contract.measured_policy: hard projection; unchanged relative to float32 input representation

common.output_clipping: none globally; local method stencils use declared value bounds

quincunx_spectral.geometry_G: quincunx reciprocal diamond |fx|+|fy| <= 0.5 cycles/full-pixel; ambiguous boundary retained at half gain
quincunx_spectral.G_transfer: 2 below diamond radius .46, 1+cos(pi*t) on [.46,.54], zero above .54
quincunx_spectral.RB_transfer: product of axis factors 2 below abs(f)=.23, 1+cos(pi*t) on [.23,.27], zero above .27
quincunx_spectral.spatial_window: separable Tukey: 1 for |offset|<=32; half cosine to zero at48
quincunx_spectral.cardinality: analytic zero of all non-central observed-sublattice coefficients; center coefficient1
quincunx_spectral.DC_normalization: divide each missing output phase by same-colour sublattice kernel sum
quincunx_spectral.implementation: compact FIR evaluated with reflected padding and FFT valid convolution in512 cores
quincunx_spectral.overshoot: sinc ringing is allowed and must be measured; no hidden clamp

nedi_covariance.mechanism: local same-colour low/high-resolution covariance duality, 4 predictors, constrained sum(weights)=1 ridge autoregression
nedi_covariance.RB_passes: four diagonal original sites fill cell centers; then same-colour checkerboard cross pass
nedi_covariance.ridge: 0.015*trace(A) + n*(4*noise_sigma**2 + 1e-12), applied to I+ones constrained-coordinate matrix
nedi_covariance.output_bound: min/max of four immediate same-colour predictors

weno_directional.mechanism: two overlapping quadratic midpoint polynomials, WENO smoothness weights, then six-direction same-colour fusion
weno_directional.RB_passes: diagonal target-lattice pass then checkerboard pass
weno_directional.output_bound: each direction polynomial clipped to four-sample stencil min/max before convex fusion

references.title: New edge-directed interpolation, Li and Orchard (2001)
WENO based adaptive image zooming algorithm
references.role: polynomial smoothness weighting inspiration only; not reproduction

references.title: Reciprocal lattice interpolation transfer
references.role: direct independent Fourier sampling derivation, not a named-paper implementation

limitations: No recovery guarantee beyond the selected-colour sample lattice Nyquist region; aliasing has already destroyed identifiability.
No optical PSF/pixel-aperture inversion or generative super-resolution; detail inference is conditional interpolation.
Spectral rolloff and finite support trade bandwidth for ringing and boundary behavior; hard projection cannot undo input aliases.
Hard measurement preservation also preserves measured noise and defects.
NEDI/WENO local bounds can suppress legitimate unsampled extrema or low-SNR textures.
All WENO/NEDI equations here are independent inspired implementations, not reproductions of 2001/2025/2026 papers.
Cross-colour spectral overlap is a sensor property and is not undone by choosing sites.
